bias.en: Bearish · bounce stalled at the $50.8 February high
bias.zh: 看空 · 反弹受阻于 2 月高点 $50.8

read.en: AAOI rose 6.9% on Nov 6 to $50.13, trading $45.15–51.90 on heavy volume. It remains below the falling 5-day ($56.55), 10-day ($66.21), 30-day ($86.11) and 100-day ($108.37) and the rising 200-day ($114.65) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, with the histogram still widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($67.16), and RSI is 30.
read.zh: AAOI 11月6日上涨 6.9%，收于 $50.13，盘中区间 $45.15–51.90，成交量明显放大。股价仍位于下行的 5 日（$56.55）、10 日（$66.21）、30 日（$86.11）和 100 日均线（$108.37）以及上行的 200 日均线（$114.65）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方，柱状图仍在扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$67.16），RSI 为 30。

read.en: The rebound reached $51.90 but closed just under the $50.8 Feb 11 high, and the $45.15 low dipped under the Nov 5 low before recovering. Resistance is $50.8–51.9, then $56.6–57.3 (5-day, Nov 5 high, Nov 4 low) and $61.9–62.3 (Nov 2–3 lows). Support is $45.2–45.9 (Nov 5–6 lows), then $41.1–42.0. A close above $51.9 would target $56.6–57.3; below $45.2, $41–42.
